title: MarketplaceAvailabilityPushed v1 payload
description: A marketplace partner is now known to hold a new availability for one mapped dish (ADR 0040, ADR 0141). Published by the availability reconciler when the partner answered a state-set with a success and the platform's belief about that dish moved: it was unknown or different before. A resend that repeats an already confirmed value, a refused push and a push whose outcome is unknown publish nothing. Identifiers, a boolean and a sequence only: the partner's own item id is the partner's identifier for a dish, never a name, and nothing here is personal data (ADR 0029). A consumer resolves the dish's name through the authorized catalog API with variantId.
